rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Registration name: WEKblufytirar
Exhibition name: Arctic Blue ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, before 2015).
Introduced in United States by Spring Hill Nurseries in 2017 as 'Arctic Blue'.
rows.Bloom: Lavender, white reverse. Mild, fruity, sweet fragrance. 33 to 55 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm). Width: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders or cut flower. Drought resistant. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
